name: policy
description: Pure Lua policy decisions and read-only rule explanations; approval and sandbox enforcement remain with their existing owners.

default.doc: The answer for a tool no rule names: allow, ask or deny.

tools.doc: Per-tool answers, overriding the default. Approval, where it happens, happens at the client; every granted dispatch still lands in the observation journal under its caller and turn.

operations.doc: Per-operation answers within a tool, which take precedence over its tool-level answer.

run.description: Runs the module through its supported application entry point.

policy.description: Decide a tool call: {tool, op?, ...} -> {decision, reason, revision}.

policy.explain.description: Explain the configured rules: {tool?} -> {default, tools, operations, revision}.
